versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the 唐诗三百首对诗挑战游戏 skill.
- Challenge mode: provides an upper line from the Tang Poems, users answer with the lower line.
- End-of-challenge scoring based on correct answers and completion time.
- Error analysis: shows correct answers and explanations for incorrect responses.
- Customizable challenge length; default is 10 questions.
- Uses data from 唐诗三百首 (tang_poetry.json).
- Clear process and feedback to help users learn and enjoy Tang poetry.
